episode.title: One World, Two Samples
episode.summary: Compare two finite samples from the same generating World.
learning.fit-first.title: Fit the first sample
learning.fit-first.body: Fit the current model to the observations already drawn.
learning.choose.title: Choose what to do next
learning.choose.body: Keep this sample, or draw another sample from the same World.
learning.sample.title: Draw another sample
learning.sample.body: The World stays fixed while the finite observations are sampled again.
learning.fit-second.title: Fit the new sample
learning.fit-second.body: Fit the current model to the newly sampled observations.
learning.compare.title: Compare the two fits
learning.compare.body: Inspect the recorded fits; the comparison is not causal proof.
learning.end.title: Comparison complete
learning.end.body: These results describe this run and do not establish mastery.
questions.fit-first: What does this fit describe about the current observations?
questions.choose-next: Would you like to keep this sample or draw another?
questions.sample: What changed in the finite observations while the World stayed fixed?
questions.fit-second: How does the new fit compare with the first one?
questions.compare: Which differences can you observe in these two fits?
agent.local.fit: Wait for the real fit to finish.
agent.local.sample: Sampling changes Data, not the World.
director.first-fit: Show the fit to the first sample.
director.second-fit: Show the fit to the second sample.
